parameters.name: DagId
parameters.description: The task flow ID, which is the unique identifier of the task flow. You can obtain this parameter by calling the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation.

parameters.name: DagNotificationFail
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable notifications when the task flow fails. This feature is disabled by default. Manually enable it.

parameters.name: DagNotificationSla
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the global SLA notification switch for the task flow. This feature is disabled by default. Manually enable it.

parameters.name: DagNotificationSuccess
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable notifications when the task flow succeeds. This feature is disabled by default. Manually enable it.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
